context.zh: 其令禮儀使與禮官博士，約古今舊儀及《開元禮》，詳定公主、郡縣主出降、覿見之文儀以聞。」
context.literal: Let the commissioner of rites and the ritual officials and erudites, drawing on ancient and modern old rites and the Kaiyuan Rites, work out in detail the written rites for princesses and commandery and county princesses marrying down and for presentation audiences, and report them."

context.zh: 初，開元中置禮會院於崇仁裏。
context.literal: At first, in the Kaiyuan era a Rites Assembly Court was established in Chongren Lane.
